responsibility: This definition module declares the Logitech-compatible process exit-code interface for GNU Modula-2. It exports procedures to set and query the exit status used for normal termination and to terminate the application, separating exit-status control from general runtime halting or diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the ErrorCode pair: it declares the public exit-status operations SetErrorCode, GetErrorCode, and ExitToOS, while ErrorCode.mod implements the stored state and runtime hookup.
